# Your Duo. Your creative studio.

Turn both screens into a mirror, adjustable light, moving color canvas, photo surface and space for personal ideas.

Download on the App Store Explore features

LumaFold creative studio interface

Designed around two screens

## One device. More ways to create.

Give each side of the display a purpose. Use mirror, light, color, animation, photography and drawing independently or together.

Mirror  Live preview + soft light

Light  Brightness + warmth

Color  Independent tones

Creative  Photos + motion + drawing

Mirror + Light 

## Your everyday glow. [...] Mirror + Light 

## Your everyday glow.

Use one side as a live mirror and the other as a soft light. Adjust warmth and brightness until everything feels right.

 ✓ Live front-camera mirror.
 ✓ Adjustable brightness and warmth.
 ✓ Close-up and makeup modes.

LumaFold mirror and beauty light

Light + Color 

## Two sides. Any mood.

Give each side its own tone and intensity. Match them, contrast them or build a completely different atmosphere.

 ✓ Independent colors.
 ✓ Separate brightness control.
 ✓ Warm, cool and contrasting combinations.

LumaFold color and brightness controls

Light + Moving Pattern 

## Color in motion.

Turn static light into movement. Shape animated gradients, waves and patterns for reflections, backgrounds and creative scenes. [...] Full screen Let the display become the light.

Disclaimer: LumaFold uses the device screen and camera to support lighting, mirror, photo and creative workflows. It is not a calibrated studio light, medical device, professional color reference tool, or camera replacement. Results depend on device brightness, environment, distance, angle, subject material and system settings.

## More than a second screen.

Light. Color. Motion. Photos. Drawing. Two surfaces ready for whatever the moment needs.
